resources.string: Automatic shows the decoded source pixel in its own color space. RGB and HEX use that same encoding on a 0–255 scale. Choose a color space to convert this pixel.
This color exceeds the 0–1 range. RGB and HEX are clipped; floating-point components and CSS retain the full values.
Rec.2020 uses the CSS Color 4 BT.1886 transfer function. Automatic retains the source encoding, including HLG and PQ.
CMYK approximates the clipped sRGB color without a printer profile.
